settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Choose the room temperature sensor, remote protocol, and polling interval.

capture.title: IR capture
capture.description: Choose a capture duration, wait for the receiving screen, then press the remote toward P3. Capture lasts up to 5 minutes and pauses control.

capture_result.title: Capture results
capture_result.description: Saved {count} waveforms with {errors} incomplete or invalid frames. Copy the JSON below or download integration diagnostics. Select the checkbox to apply the latest captured remote settings to the HA climate card.

outlet_off.title: Turn off outlet: risk confirmation
outlet_off.description: This cuts mains power to the AC. Cutting power during startup or operation may cause damage. Turn the AC off and verify it has stopped first. HA records do not confirm its physical state.

data.confirm: I understand the risk and confirm cutting outlet power

outlet_off_running.title: Confirm again: AC may be running
outlet_off_running.description: The stored AC state is on, or the latest load-power reading exceeds 100 W. Either condition is treated as running. Cutting power may cause damage. Cancel and turn the AC off first, or confirm to cut mains power immediately.

capturing.title: Receiving remote signals
capturing.description: Point the remote toward P3 and press its buttons. Choose Stop and view results when finished. The time limit saves the capture automatically. Closing this window ends capture; reopen View/export last capture to see the saved results.

local_mode.title: Operating mode
local_mode.description:
Current: {status}.

Local mode stops the Mijia cloud client while retaining HA local control. HA reapplies it after reconnecting following a device restart; the cloud client may run while HA is offline.

The first activation saves the original monitor under `/data/aqara_p3/local-mode-v1/` on the device. Restoring Mijia cloud removes the runtime overlay and retains the backup.

progress.receiving: Ready: press your remote now. Results appear after capture finishes.

error.local_mode_backup_conflict: Device backup validation failed. Check the original backup before retrying.
error.local_mode_system_changed: The monitor script or mount has changed. Check existing device modifications.
error.local_mode_busy: A mode change or IR capture is in progress. Try again later.
error.local_mode_rollback_failed: Rollback did not complete. Check the device over Telnet and restore its operating mode.

abort.capture_failed: Capture did not complete. Reception stopped; reopen options to try again.
abort.outlet_off_done: The device acknowledged the outlet power-off command.
abort.outlet_failed: The outlet operation did not complete. Check the device state.
abort.outlet_on_done: The device acknowledged restoring outlet power.
